headline: Cadbury Nigeria Reports N14.48 Billion Pre-Tax Profit
summary: Cadbury Nigeria Plc recorded a pre-tax profit of N14.48 billion on revenue of N126.69 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
why: Cadbury Nigeria is a prominent fast-moving consumer goods manufacturer listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Cadbury Nigeria Plc
impacts.why: Higher revenue and pre-tax profit indicate stronger operational performance and improved earnings for shareholders.
